summary: Iteration 18 verified end-to-end. Backend 8/8 pytest pass (auth, 5 agents, empty queue/orders/metrics with zero counts, cascade processed:0, WhatsApp 3 approved templates, connectors endpoint). Frontend: Sidebar renders exactly the 5 top-level items (nav-copilot/pedidos/conexiones/metricas/ajustes); no legacy nav-* testids present. All 4 hubs render their tab-sets and embed sub-pages with exactly ONE Sidebar (aside=1 on /app/pedidos, /app/conexiones, /app/metricas, /app/ajustes). Copilot greeting 'Hola QA Two, soy Marcus — tu Copilot de 5 agentes.' + 5 agent cards with single-line Spanish hints + cascade-open-btn + copilot-right-rail all present. Queue Cola tab empty-state buttons (queue-empty-import / queue-empty-connect) present and queue-empty-import navigates to /app/pedidos?tab=importar. Métricas empty-state (metricas-empty) with both CTAs present; metricas-cta-importar navigates correctly. Connector cards for chatea_pro, dropi, telnyx, elevenlabs all present with 'Cómo conectar' toggles. Legacy redirects all pass (queue/import/products/metrics/connectors/skills).

ui_bugs.issue: Dropi connector card lacks a 'Probar' button (connector-test-dropi is absent). Other connectors (chatea_pro, telnyx, elevenlabs) all have the test button. Per spec each card should include one.

issues: Copilot page has 3 <aside> elements (Sidebar + ThreadsPanel + right-rail). Only nav-copilot testid count is 1 — the review acceptance criterion is met via the nav-copilot fallback, but the raw <aside> heuristic would trip. This is by design (Copilot bypasses Layout). No functional bug.

action_items: (Optional) Add a `connector-test-dropi` 'Probar' button to the Dropi connector card in /app/frontend/src/pages/Connectors.jsx for parity with other connectors.
critical_code_review_comments: HubContext.js correctly signals `useInHub()` and Layout.jsx returns bare children in that case — only one Sidebar renders on hub pages (aside=1 verified for all 4 hubs).

PedidosPage/ConexionesPage/AjustesPage read `?tab=` on mount but also call `window.history.replaceState` on tab switch — this bypasses react-router. Because URL is external state only, direct back-button navigation between tabs will not work. Consider `useSearchParams` for proper history integration.

Metricas.jsx: `norte.recovery_rate?.value` and `roi.recovered_value_cop` come from GET /api/metrics; verified endpoint returns 200 with zero values so empty-state kicks in correctly (orders_total==0).

Copilot.jsx duplicates the Layout chrome (Sidebar + ThreadsPanel + right-rail) rather than using Layout. This is fine for the wide 3-aside layout, but produces 3 <aside> tags — anyone auditing 'one sidebar per page' with an aside-count assertion should use `nav-copilot` count instead as the review already notes.
test_iteration_18.py: uses the module-level login fixture (email + password) to obtain HttpOnly JWT cookie; X-API-Key header still set for legacy-gated routes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on required assertions (1 minor missing Probar button on Dropi)
